hypothesis_labels_why: Every hypothesis kind, and the words a person reads for it. This map is the one source of both: its keys are the kind set Go and Python validate against, and its values are the labels. cli/internal/model/investigation.go (HypothesisLabels) and frontend/src/lib/hypotheses.ts carry copies, because neither build can reach this file at run time; a test in each language fails unless its copy equals this map exactly, so a kind with no label, or a label that differs, cannot ship.
